coppe-01.exo: The principle of love, joy and emotional fertility. It announces a new feeling, a reconciliation, a gift, a period of the heart opening.
coppe-01.psy: The capacity to receive: the heart that empties itself so that it can be filled. It invites you to lower your defences and let life touch you.
coppe-01.ini: The Ace in Kether: the root of Water and the first He of the Tetragrammaton, the Mother as a cup receiving the Father's force. Its throne is the celestial quadrant of Libra, Scorpio and Sagittarius, governed by the Princess of Cups.
coppe-01.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals sentimentality, overflowing emotion, a dependence on the need to be loved.
coppe-01.up: The heart opens: welcome what arrives without calculating. A favourable moment for love, creativity and emotional healing.
coppe-01.rev: Emotions held back or drained, difficulty receiving; or a wave of feeling that drowns judgement.
coppe-01.love: A new love, declarations, reconciliation, deep intimacy possible.
coppe-01.work: A harmonious environment, projects born from sincere passion, caring or artistic work.
coppe-01.spirit: The inner Grail: receptivity as the condition of grace.
coppe-01.crowley: Crowley paints the Holy Grail resting on a crescent moon and receiving a ray of white light from above, over a sea of lotuses: the Cup as the matrix of the supreme Mother.

coppe-02.exo: Love, friendship, reciprocity, harmony between two people or two parts. It points to a happy meeting, an agreement, a sincere reconciliation.
coppe-02.psy: The experience of mirroring yourself in another and recognising yourself; the wish to share that comes from fullness, not from lack.
coppe-02.ini: Water in Chokmah, the original force of love, with Venus in Cancer in the first decan: affection in its tenderest and most protective form. Love is the will to union that precedes every form, the polarity that recognises and attracts itself.
coppe-02.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals infatuation, emotional dependence, sentimentality or dissolving into a relationship.
coppe-02.up: A harmonious union is possible or already under way: cultivate it with openness and reciprocity.
coppe-02.rev: Imbalance in the relationship, expectations not returned, difficulty communicating feelings.
coppe-02.love: Mutual falling in love, engagement, reconciliation after a misunderstanding.
coppe-02.work: Happy partnerships, harmonious collaborations, agreements based on trust.
coppe-02.spirit: Love as law: polarity reconciled into unity.
coppe-02.crowley: In the Thoth deck two intertwined dolphins rise from a lotus and pour water into two cups on a calm sea: love as the harmony of polarities.

coppe-03.exo: Abundance, celebration, fertility, joy shared with others. It points to parties, gatherings, moments of grace and a generous emotional harvest.
coppe-03.psy: The joy that is born from sharing; the pleasure of receiving and giving without calculation. It calls for awareness so that abundance does not become dispersal.
coppe-03.ini: Water in Binah, the Great Mother, with Mercury in Cancer in the second decan: love becomes fertile, shared form. Abundance is the fullness of the Mother, which however calls for care not to be taken for granted.
coppe-03.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals excess, dissipation, fleeting pleasures, superficiality.
coppe-03.up: A moment of joy and abundance: share it and celebrate with those you love.
coppe-03.rev: Too much celebration, pleasures that empty out, difficulty enjoying what you have.
coppe-03.love: Joy, celebrations, possibly happy news, even of a pregnancy.
coppe-03.work: Collective success, a close-knit team, projects that bear fruit.
coppe-03.spirit: Gratitude as recognition of divine abundance.
coppe-03.crowley: Crowley draws three cups in the shape of pomegranates overflowing from lotuses: the fruit of Persephone, sweet but bound to the underworld, a reminder of the price of every abundance.

coppe-04.exo: Comfort, pleasure, emotional stability, but also the beginning of weariness and boredom. It points to a satisfied emotional situation that risks becoming static.
coppe-04.psy: The wish for emotional security which, once satisfied, risks turning into immobility: you guard what you have for fear of losing it, and meanwhile the feeling stops flowing.
coppe-04.ini: Water in Chesed, Mercy, with the Moon in Cancer in the third decan: emotion becomes a reassuring habit. Luxury is established pleasure, but stagnant water already contains the seed of decay.
coppe-04.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals apathy, satiety, complacency, a refusal to grow.
coppe-04.up: Enjoy what you have, but stay alert: emotional stability can become a gilded cage.
coppe-04.rev: Boredom, dissatisfaction, a wish for something more; or resistance to emotional change.
coppe-04.love: A comfortable, reassuring relationship, perhaps a little routine; wellbeing needs renewing with small new gestures.
coppe-04.work: A stable position, but perhaps unstimulating; a risk of stagnation.
coppe-04.spirit: Telling the nourishment that sustains apart from the gilded cage that lulls to sleep.
coppe-04.crowley: In the Thoth deck four cups rest on a square base above a stormy sea: stability built on the instability of the emotions.

coppe-05.exo: Disappointment, loss, betrayed expectations. It points to breakups, regrets, wounded feelings and the need to process grief, often arriving just when everything seemed calm.
coppe-05.psy: The backlash of a collapsing illusion: frustration can turn into bitterness if it is not acknowledged and mourned, or into maturity if it is understood.
coppe-05.ini: Water in Geburah, Severity, with Mars in Scorpio in the first decan: Martial fire makes the waters evaporate. Disappointment is emotion colliding with reality, the necessary pain of purification.
coppe-05.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals victimhood, resentment, despair, a fixation on the past.
coppe-05.up: Acknowledge the loss and let the pain flow: not everything is lost, but you need time to process before starting again.
coppe-05.rev: Grief denied or prolonged; you fix on what is missing and do not see what remains.
coppe-05.love: Disappointments, separations, unrequited feelings; the heart asks for time and honesty.
coppe-05.work: Failed projects or unmet expectations; review goals and alliances.
coppe-05.spirit: Disappointment as liberation from illusions and a first step toward a truer love.
coppe-05.crowley: Crowley depicts five empty cups arranged in an inverted pentagram, with withered lotuses and a dead sea: love parched by Martial fire.

coppe-06.exo: Pleasure, wellbeing, emotional and physical harmony. It points to a period of joy, of health regained, of satisfaction in relationships and of desires that find natural fulfilment.
coppe-06.psy: The ability to enjoy love and life without guilt and without excess; the emotional balance that makes pleasure nourishing and not compulsive.
coppe-06.ini: Water in Tiphareth, the harmonious heart, with the Sun in Scorpio in the second decan: solar fire warms the deep waters. Pleasure is emotion in balance, the joy born of vital fullness.
coppe-06.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals hedonism, vanity, a pursuit of superficial pleasures.
coppe-06.up: A period of joy and emotional harmony: welcome it with gratitude and let it renew your energies.
coppe-06.rev: Pleasure that runs out or becomes habit; difficulty enjoying, nostalgia for a past wellbeing.
coppe-06.love: A harmonious, sensual relationship, wellbeing as a couple, a rediscovery of shared pleasure.
coppe-06.work: Satisfaction, a positive climate, calm successes achieved without forcing.
coppe-06.spirit: Pleasure as an expression of grace: sensuality made holy by awareness.
coppe-06.crowley: In the Thoth deck six lotuses pour water into six cups without making them overflow: pleasure in its perfect measure, fertility without excess.

coppe-07.exo: Excess, fantasies, temptations, dispersal in pleasures. It points to confused choices, desires that intoxicate, seductive promises that do not stand the test of facts.
coppe-07.psy: The seduction of illusion: you flee into fantasy or immediate gratification so as not to feel an emptiness. It asks you to ask yourself what you are really looking for.
coppe-07.ini: Water in Netzach, emotional but unstable Victory, with Venus in Scorpio, her sign of detriment, in the third decan: love loses measure and is corrupted into craving. Debauch is pleasure which, deprived of Tiphareth, rots upon itself.
coppe-07.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals addictions, systematic self-deception, moral corruption, toxic environments.
coppe-07.up: Beware of illusions and of pleasures that promise too much: tell authentic desire apart from escape.
coppe-07.rev: Waking from a spell and becoming aware; or a deeper fall into dependence if it continues to be denied.
coppe-07.love: Temptations, ambiguous or toxic relationships, idealisations bound to shatter.
coppe-07.work: Vague projects, offers too good to be true, a dispersal of energy and resources.
coppe-07.spirit: Purifying desire: telling living water from stagnant.
coppe-07.crowley: Crowley paints seven iridescent cups dripping a viscous liquid, while the lotuses have turned into poisonous tiger lilies above a swamp: pleasure corrupted.
